decision_points.question: which covariates and functional forms make up the adjusted model's control set?
decision_points.why_rival: each names one control set for the single primary regression (league in/out, position in/out, age, yellow cards, referee-bias measures, raw/log/quadratic games); an analyst commits to one adjustment specification

decision_points.question: how are the model's standard errors / uncertainty estimated?
decision_points.why_rival: player-clustered vs HC1 robust are mutually exclusive variance-estimation methods for the same fit

decision_points.question: which statistical model family is used for the outcome instead of plain logistic?
decision_points.why_rival: Poisson/count model, linear-probability model, and mixed-effects model are alternative estimators; only one drives the primary outcome model

decision_points.question: how is the skin-tone exposure entered into the regression — dichotomized at a cutpoint or kept continuous?
decision_points.why_rival: a 0.25 cutoff, a 0.5 cutoff, and a continuous measure are mutually exclusive codings of the same exposure variable

decision_points.question: into how many bins is skin tone grouped for descriptive rates?
decision_points.why_rival: 9 vs 10 bins are rival granularities for the same descriptive grouping

decision_points.question: how many categories is player position collapsed into?
decision_points.why_rival: 3, 4, 5, or 6 position buckets are mutually exclusive recodings of the position variable

decision_points.question: how are reference/baseline categories handled for the categorical dummies?
decision_points.why_rival: hand-picking reference levels vs keeping every dummy level (dropping none) are alternative dummy-encoding schemes

decision_points.question: how are records with missing position/skin-tone values handled?
decision_points.why_rival: complete-case / dropping the unmeasured records vs recoding them as an explicit 'Unknown' category each dispose of the same missing records differently

decision_points.question: how is effect modification / moderation of the skin-tone effect tested?
decision_points.why_rival: alternative interaction/moderation specifications answering whether the skin-tone effect varies across groups

decision_points.question: how are descriptive red-card rates aggregated and tabulated across groups?
decision_points.why_rival: grouping by position, by skin-tone × position, or by skin-tone group alone are rival framings for the descriptive rate summary

decision_points.question: which positions are included in the descriptive position × skin-tone crosstab?
decision_points.why_rival: settles the scope of positions shown in the descriptive crosstab

decision_points.question: how is the exploratory disciplinary-outcome model without skin tone specified (club + position)?
decision_points.why_rival: both specify the same club/team-plus-position model that omits skin tone; the single co-run is the same slot recorded twice, not two rivals run together
